synopsis: It is October, Cosmic Era 71. The Second Battle of Yakin Due has brought about the end of the war between Earth and PLANT. Jess Rabble, a mobile suit pilot, journalist and cameraman, wishes to photograph the truth of the world from a mobile suit's perspective. During an encounter with the Junk Guild, he meets Lowe Gear, who offers him the newly completed Astray Out Frame in order to fulfill his goal. Now, with Lowe's talking computer '8' at his side, Jess ventures off to all corners of the Earth to film the new battles the world faces. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
titleRomaji: Isekai ni Otosareta... Jouka wa Kihon! @COMIC
titleEnglish: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
titleNative: 異世界に落とされた…浄化は基本！＠COMIC
synonyms: Summoned to Another World... Purification Is basic!
synopsis: Akira Tennou, an unremarkable thirty-five-year-old man, gets hit by a truck on his way home from work and, after a brief experience in some mystical limbo, wakes up in a gloomy forest. This forest is beset by a sinister black mist—his memories of his little sister's lectures about fantasy novels tell him that it's probably under an evil curse. He soon encounters one of the forest's residents: an enormous silver wolf. At first the creature is hostile, but he finds that it's been corrupted by the same black mist, and he only needs to cry "Purify!" to banish the curse and heal the wolf. Akira discovers that the residents of the forest are all animals, and once purified, they are far from feral beasts. His newfound magic allows him to speak to his new animal companions; he finds that they are intelligent and the rightful rulers of the forest. Akira decides to explore this new world, purifying the land and its inhabitants as he goes. But the source of the cursed mist can't be far away... (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: Hashi Sarnan is the orphaned son of a ministerial family and lives under the protection of his guardian, his uncle Kiiya. He loves ancient temples and, while working on their restoration, he heard the voice of the sky god Teselan in a dream, and upon waking, the blueprints for the temple were imprinted in his mind. One day, in the old town market, he almost has his wallet stolen by a pickpocket named Shirato. Later, he hides Shirato, who has killed a white man and his ex-wife and fled to the temple, but Shirato, whose conscience has awakened while helping Cernan with the temple's restoration work, is shot and killed by police officers who deliberately pursued him. synopsis: Upon awakening, a little girl named Lezay finds herself standing alone in an unfamiliar meadow. In front stands a massive dog. Such a creature had never been seen near home before. At that moment, a conclusion forms that this must be what is called reincarnation into another world. Soon, a band of muscular mercenaries appears, seemingly on a mission to subdue the giant dog. However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members! (Source: Alpha Manga)
